title: 第498章 服装艺术之城第497章 警钟
slug: 你好是寄往魔神堡垒的信吗
lines: 摩根用自己，为林鬼和艾尔维亚换来了时间。
大贤者的威胁被暂时推后了。
但那份三年之约，却像一把悬在头顶的刀，始终没有落下。
如果三年内摩根成功了，万事大吉。
如果他失败了，血珀上的灵魂细线断开的那一刻，大贤者的目光将会重新落在那些半魔身上。
落在塞德里克、弗里曼、莉亚，落在那些正在前往龙骨城的半魔平民身上。
届时，林鬼将会直面来自大贤者的威胁。
林鬼和艾尔维亚没有在原地停留太久。
恢复了些许力量之后，他们便重新出发。
飞舟从荒原边缘升起，带着两人向着东边飞去。
接下来的一个半月。
他们穿过暮色森林，在白杨堡短暂停留了几天。
在那里开设了一间邮局，收了一批信，然后再度启程。
他们飞过诅咒沼泽，掠过那些灰绿色的雾气和水潭，最终抵达了绿荫廷。
绿荫廷是中央城邦中最年轻的一座，修筑不过1年多。
它的城墙不高，街道整齐，建筑风格带着一种精致的新意，像是刚被精心打磨过的工艺品。
而这座城市在阿卡拉还有一个特殊的地位。
服装艺术之城。
几乎整个中央城邦圈的中高档服饰，都出自绿荫廷的设计师之手。
这里的裁缝和设计师们掌握着最流行的剪裁和配色。
每年都有无数商人从远方赶来，只为了抢到新一季的设计样稿。
所以，在踏入城门的那一刻，艾尔维亚的双眼就亮了。
她甚至没有跟林鬼打招呼。
像一头野狼嗅到了血腥，艾尔维亚一头扎进了最近的一家服饰店。
然后就被那满墙的布料和成衣彻底吞没了。
林鬼没有拦她。
他按照以往的习惯，去购置产业的地方准备买地开邮局。
但让他意外的是，接待他的是绿荫廷的最高统治者。
那位穿着深色长袍的中年城主亲自等在门口。
见到他时笑容满面，像迎接一位远道而来的贵客。
半个月的时间，第四支不死烈阳诞生的消息已经传遍了整个阿卡拉。
content_en:
Morgan used himself to buy time for Lin Gui and Elvia.
The Great Sage's threat was temporarily postponed.
But that three-year agreement was like a knife hanging above my head, never falling.
If Morgan succeeds within three years, all will be well.
If he fails, the moment the soul thread on the blood amulet is disconnected, the great sage's eyes will fall on those half-demon again.
It fell on Cedric, Freeman, Leah, and the half-demon civilians who were heading to Dragonbone City.
At that time, Lin Gui will face the threat from the Great Sage.
Lin Gui and Elvia did not stay where they were for long.
After regaining some strength, they set off again.
The flying boat rose from the edge of the wasteland and took the two of them flying towards the east.
The next month and a half.
They passed through the Dusk Forest and stopped briefly at Poplar Castle for a few days.
He opened a post office there, collected a batch of letters, and then set off again.
They flew over the Cursed Swamp, passing through the gray-green mist and pools, and finally arrived at the Green Shade Court.
Green Yin Pavilion is the youngest building in the central city-state. It was built for just over a year.
Its city walls are not high, its streets are neat, and its architectural style has a delicate newness, like a handicraft that has just been carefully polished.
And this city also has a special status in Akala.
The city of costume art.
Almost all the mid-to-high-end clothing in the central city-state circle is made by designers from Luyinting.
The tailors and designers here have the most popular cuts and colors.
Every year, countless businessmen come from far away just to grab the design samples of the new season.
Therefore, the moment he stepped into the city gate, Elvia's eyes lit up.
She didn't even say hello to the Lin Kuei.
Like a wild wolf smelling blood, Alvia dove into the nearest clothing store.
Then I was completely swallowed up by the wall-to-wall fabrics and ready-made clothes.
Lin Gui didn't stop her.
According to his past habit, he went to the place where he purchased the property to buy land and open a post office.
But what surprised him was that the person who received him was the supreme ruler of the Green Yin Court.
The middle-aged city lord wearing dark robes was waiting at the door in person.
When I saw him, my face was full of smiles, as if I were welcoming a distinguished guest from afar.
In half a month, the news of the birth of the fourth Immortal Sun has spread throughout Akara.
